name: SwanStationPS5
description: SwanStationPS5 is a PlayStation 1 emulator that runs all games using SwanStation core.
author: AngelXex
release_notes:
Library
- Settings opened from the library (Square) now offer This game / All games (L2 / R2) for the game under the cursor, just like the in-game menu. Per-game settings are saved and restored from the library too.
- Pressing Triangle on a game now clears the shelf: the other cases fade out, the chosen case slides to the left of the details panel, and the title and tags hide. Closing the panel brings everything back.
- The right stick now tilts and turns the case while the details panel is open, exactly as it does when it is closed.
- Covers are always flat: the "Cover art" option (3D box covers) has been removed.

Game launch animation
- The case lid now opens to 130 degrees (it used to open to 110).
- The CD inside the case now picks up the scene light like the paper does, plus a soft metallic highlight.
- The whole screen now fades to black before the game starts, with no flash of the shelf on the last frame.

Details panel
- The disc tip now says the swap shortcut (hold the touchpad + R1) works while playing.
- Removed the "Runs on SwanStation" tip, since SwanStation is the only core.

Other
- The log now records the build date and time at startup, to tell which build is running.

Note: after updating, the app asks once to reset settings to factory defaults. Accepting it also clears per-game settings.
